# Neutral host fixtures

`neutral-icon.png` is a newly authored 64×64 geometric PNG used to exercise
addon icon validation and publication without any real site's assets. It is
CC0-1.0. It contains no scraped or copyrighted gallery content.

Real site addon implementations, icons and source-specific fixtures live in
[JavaScript source packages in nova-addons](https://github.com/misobarisic/nova-addons/tree/main/reader-addons).
